notes.title: Patch 1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes: Esc keyboard event now properly brings up the settings menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed the Stalker AI either not moving or not attacking. They SHOULD work properly now. 

Fixed the Health bar not showing up and the damage from the attack not being applied properly. 

Fixed the Health value resetting upon level change, save, and reload. 

Added a recharge delay to the Flashlight to avoid bypassing its charge state, which should reduce its abuse. 

Added a better Indicator to find the entrance to the City Memory. 

Fixed a few out of place meshes.

notes.title: Fix Inbound
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! 

I have been made aware of some random game-breaking bugs that have been brought to my attention. I am currently working to fix these bugs and improve performance, I hope to have a fix by tonight or tomorrow morning.  

I apologize for the inconvenience.

FlabberGhast
Ghast Games Studio

notes.title: Unexpected Delay
notes.notes:
Unfortunately, due to an oversight on my part, the game's release will be delayed. We are awaiting a final build review from Steam and will release it as soon as possible. We will keep you updated and make an announcement. 
This delay is due to my inexperience with the Steamworks platform, build configurations, and testing practices. Moving forward, we will ensure that games are in a live build state before announcing a release date so we can avoid this error in the future. We hope that this does not discourage you from playing A Tale of Misery or continuing to support us. We are eager to develop, launch, and support our titles properly and will work relentlessly to improve our development cycle.
